g.text: Dual hinge mechanism · hard stops, indexing and proposed retention
C3 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · INCHES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY — NOT FOR FABRICATION
Guard and pin head omitted for clarity. Solid contact faces remain from the CAD assembly.
Exact part outlines translated for visibility; displayed gaps are expanded.
Moving sector: 0.5000 thick; running gap 0.0625 per side.
Bushing: Ø1.000 OD / Ø0.753 ID × 0.500 long.
Pin end fastener, bearing fit and anti-rotation detail require selection.
1. Support the empty seat; retract both captive locking pins.
2. Rotate to the hard stop; keep hands outside the mechanism.
3. Re-engage each pin through both cheeks and the sector hole.
4. Confirm full engagement and anti-release retention before boarding.
Captive sleeve / detent selection is unfinished; this is design intent.
Two identical mechanisms support one seat. Hinge axes must be aligned in one fixture; final coaxiality, fits, finish and weld sequence are not assigned.
Hard stops define deployed and stowed positions. Lock pins are separate positive-position elements; no spring or friction-only retention is assumed.
Pin loads, bearing/contact, stop welds, sector/tie welds, fatigue and abuse proof testing require final review. No hardware is released for procurement.
Face covers are only partial guards. Complete underside/tang protection, accessible handle geometry and trapped-finger testing remain open.
C3-M01 · CAD: build_c3.py / parameters.json / parts.json / drawing-edges.json
